decision_summary: Deliver the promised final go to Birgit on WhatsApp before 21:00: released and booked on SX 3418 (status worded exactly, not flown yet). Confirm to QA that it was sent and restate the 07:40 build-up cutoff. Schedule a Sunday-morning check on loading and departure.
rationale: Timeline check: seal 19:55 + 12 h 00 min = 07:55 Sun 26 Oct (validation limit). Truck collects 06:35 + 35 min = arrival ~07:10. Unit is released 07:15 and build-up closes 07:40, so boxes are inside the 2-8 C unit between 07:15 and 07:40, before 07:55. Margins: 07:55 - 07:40 = 15 min to the validation limit even at the latest loading time, and 07:40 - 07:10 = 30 min of road-delay buffer before build-up close. Arrival FRA 11:25, handler cold-room pickup from 12:30, counter from 14:00. All constraints are met on the record, so the promised final go is due now and must reach Birgit before her 21:00 cutoff. Rule 4 requires stating it as released + booked, not delivered, and not promising the arrival outright. Giuseppe asked for the confirmation, so a short reply closes his loop and puts the hard 07:40 cutoff in writing to the party that controls the truck handover.
alternatives_rejected: Hold until the flight departs: misses Birgit's 21:00 decision point and breaks the event-004 promise, whose trigger (packhouse release) has occurred.
Say no / request re-icing: not needed. The validated window (to 07:55) covers loading by the 07:40 build-up close, and re-icing is QA's call anyway.
Confirm 'everything is in order, prawns will be on your counter': over-claims delivery and the arrival outcome.
Contacting the airline again: booking and cutoffs are already confirmed in writing, so nothing new is needed from them tonight.
